name: Waitlist invite to current SourceCo users
subject: You're invited: the SourceCo Co-Invest waitlist
body:
Hi [first name],

We're opening something new to the SourceCo community first.

SourceCo Co-Invest brings independent sponsors and investors together, one deal at a time. Sponsors get a free Equity Pre-Check before they make an offer. Investors get early access, by invitation.

The waitlist takes about a minute: [link]

Bidding on a marketplace deal right now? You don't need to wait. Reply to this email and we'll start your Pre-Check.

Tomos

name: Launch to marketplace sponsors
subject: Know your equity before you bid
body:
Hi [first name],

Quick one. Starting this week, any deal on the marketplace can get an Equity Pre-Check before you bid.

What you get, in writing:
1. A first answer within 1 business day.
2. How much equity is likely, and what still has to be true.
3. The date we will decide by once you sign.

You can show it to the seller or their banker. There is no fee to sponsors.

It is not a promise to fund. Investors still decide after their own review. But it means you are not starting from zero the day the seller says yes.

I raised equity deal by deal as a sponsor, so I know what those 90 days feel like. If you are looking at anything on the marketplace right now, reply to this email or start here: [link]

Tomos

name: Pre-Check request confirmation
subject: Got your Pre-Check request for [deal code]
body:
Hi [first name],

Thanks for asking for an Equity Pre-Check on [deal code]. A person on our deal team has it.

You will hear from me within 1 business day with a first answer, or the short list of what we still need.

To speed it up, reply with:
1. Two or three deals you have closed or worked on
2. How much of your own money you plan to put in
3. How you are thinking about the structure

A Pre-Check is not a promise to fund. It is a written answer on where your equity would likely come from, and what has to be true.

[Tomos or Dan]

name: Nudge if we are waiting on them
subject: Two answers and your Pre-Check is done
body:
Hi [first name],

Quick nudge on [deal code]. We are two answers away from your written Pre-Check:

1. [What we still need]
2. [What we still need]

If the timing changed or you passed on the deal, just say so and I will close it out.

[Name]

name: The Pre-Check itself
subject: Your Equity Pre-Check: [deal code]
body:
Hi [first name],

Your Equity Pre-Check for [deal code] is attached. The short version:

About you: checked
About the deal: checked, with [one note]
Likely equity: [$X to $Y]
What has to be true: [the two or three things that have to hold]
Decision date: [N business days] after you send us your signed offer

You can share it with the seller or their banker. If they want to confirm it is real, they can reach us with the Pre-Check ID at the top.

It is not a promise to fund. Investors decide after they review the signed deal, and we will tell you the day anything changes.

Good luck with the bid.

[Tomos or Dan]

name: After they sign the offer
subject: You signed. Here is your decision date.
body:
Hi [first name],

Congrats on signing [deal code]. Your decision date from the Pre-Check is [date].

Between now and then we need:
1. Your signed offer letter
2. Your model, and how the purchase is paid for
3. When the earnings audit will be done, once you know

Once those are in, the deal goes to review. If it is a yes, the deal room opens, and you approve every page before an investor sees it.

[Name]

name: One question, for sponsors who did not reply
subject: One question
body:
Hi [first name],

Are you looking at any deals right now where the equity is not fully spoken for?

If yes, reply with the deal code or a one-line description and I will tell you within a day whether we can help.

If not, no worries. I will stay out of your inbox.

Tomos

name: To sell-side bankers and brokers
subject: If a sponsor bids on your client
body:
Hi [first name],

A quick one for the next time an independent sponsor bids on one of your clients.

We have started issuing an Equity Pre-Check to sponsors buying through SourceCo. It is a one-page written view: who the sponsor is, what we checked on the deal, how much equity is likely, what has to be true, and when we will decide once they sign.

If a sponsor shows you one, you can confirm it with us directly. If they cannot show you anything, that tells you something too.

Here is a short page you can share with clients: [link]

Happy to walk you through it.

Tomos
